title: Canonical pricing path + discovery cardinality repair
objective: Establish one canonical base-pricing serving path for every production and every canonical program: remove Little Utopia's title-based routing bypass, and fix discovery so canonical program identity (not jurisdiction_code) is the uniqueness key.

canonical_path.detail: Removed the `project.title == PRODUCTION_NAME` branch that routed Little Utopia through the legacy little_utopia_state.get_state()/build_allocated_structures() path. Every project now traverses canonical_production_view.build_production_and_structures() + build_generic_pkg_and_economics() unconditionally.

discovery.root_cause: production_discovery.py's discover_executable_jurisdictions() read program_slug from a single jurisdiction_comparison.ALL_PROFILES entry per code; canonical_evaluation.py's candidate loop additionally collapsed to the FIRST accepted/capability_only program per code via next(...) lookups.
discovery.fix: discover_executable_jurisdictions() now unions ALL_PROFILES with executable_jurisdiction_registry.all_doctrine_records() and examines every distinct (code, slug) pair independently. canonical_evaluation.py's candidate loop consumes every accepted/capability_only pair, not just the first per code. Structure identity (structure_id, and the served name/label when a code has >1 program) now incorporates program_slug to avoid collisions.
discovery.alias_duplication: none -- executable_jurisdiction_registry._REGISTRY is keyed by canonical program_slug; CANONICAL_RUNTIME_SLUG_BINDINGS aliases resolve to the same canonical slug before pricing, verified for ca_on_opstc specifically (appears in both ALL_PROFILES and the doctrine registry, examines as exactly one candidate).

npc_field_contract.npc_verified_usd_vs_npc_with_adjustments: both fields distinct on every served structure; equal today because no per-project travel/FX/in-kind/local-cost/financing/implementation input exists generically yet -- disclosed, not hidden.

ui.fix: ProjectHeader.jsx's hero now calls the SAME lib/globeData.js::activeStructure(allocated, leadingStructureId) helper Overview.jsx/Workspace.jsx/ProjectGlobe.jsx already use, instead of unconditionally reading ranking's rank===1 entry. Falls back to rank 1 only when no leading structure is explicitly selected.

runtime_verification.lu_workspace: loads, hero and scenario cards agree exactly -- browser-verified
runtime_verification.lu_scenarios: Mauritius leading, gross budget/incentive/NPC match hero exactly -- browser-verified
runtime_verification.fvd_scenarios: three independent Ontario Full Relocation rows with distinct QPE/incentive/NPC visible in Review section -- browser-verified via get_page_text
runtime_verification.api_get_project_state: confirmed 200 OK for both projects post-fix via server logs

deferred.optimizer_restoration: untouched -- discovery cardinality fix is deliberately NOT stacking (Task Important note); Ontario's 3 programs are served independently, never combined
deferred.little_utopia_legacy_demo_engine: unchanged -- app/demo/little_utopia_state.py and its own build_allocated_structures() remain in place, backing only the non-project-scoped 8 legacy routes (company-level pages with no project_id, per useCineGlobe.js's own documented behavior). No longer reachable from get_project_state.
deferred.production_validation_harness_legacy_str: the legacy demo engine's own structure dicts still carry no program_slug field (restoring that is out of scope, 'DO NOT restore optimizer structures'); production_validation_harness.py's _jurisdiction_outcomes() was patched to stop attributing an ambiguous shared structure's is_fully_priced value to a NOT-accepted examination for a multi-program code -- a minimal, diagnostic-only fix, not a re-architecture of the legacy engine's structure generation.

tests.full_suite_result: 4210 passed, 1 pre-existing out-of-scope failure (test_scenarios_and_workspace_both_use_the_canonical_title_formatter -- unrelated frontend title-formatter regression, present before this task), 1 skipped
